issue.title: Update Cybersecurity Services catalog from SECASSURED source

affected_files.role: Primary seed data (intactToolboxServices + infrastructureServices, 44 entries); seedServices() only creates missing services by shortName, never updates or removes existing ones
Mongoose schema; has no status/deprecated field, needed to satisfy 'removed or clearly deprecated' AC without breaking Scenario references
Defines category slugs services are keyed against; new SECASSURED services may need new categories added first or seeding silently skips them
NIS2 sector slugs used via sectorSlug for Critical-Infrastructure-classified services
Hardcoded category->sector mapping table that could go stale if categories change
CRUD API + Zod validation schemas; would need a new enum/field if a deprecation status is introduced
States 'Catalog of 44+ INTACT cybersecurity services' — stale count/description to update
match_reasons: contains a stale hardcoded service count

affected_files.role: OpenAPI schema for Service; would need a new enum value if a status field is added
Only auto-seeds on an empty DB; a refresh in an already-seeded deployment needs a manual reseed or migration

analysis.summary: The service catalog is defined entirely by a static, create-only seed script; seedServices() checks each entry's shortName and inserts it only if missing, so it has no path to update descriptions/categories on existing services or to remove/deprecate ones no longer in the source, and Scenario.deployedServices[].serviceId references Service documents with no cascade-delete handling, making hard deletion unsafe.
analysis.details: Refreshing the catalog from SECASSURED requires more than editing the seed arrays: (1) changed services need the create-if-missing path extended to also update mutable fields on existing matches, (2) services no longer in the source need a safe removal story given Scenario references, and (3) new categories referenced by new services must be added to categories.seed.ts first or seedServices() silently skips them with a console error. No automated tests exist in this repo to catch regressions from this change.

options.name: Hard removal + create-only refresh
options.summary: Delete Service docs no longer in the source list; keep create-only upsert for the rest.

files_to_modify.changes: Replace catalog arrays with refreshed SECASSURED data; add deletion of removed shortNames

cons: Orphans Scenario.deployedServices references to deleted services
No update path for changed descriptions/categories on existing services
options.risk_details: Silent data loss and orphaned scenario references with no automated tests to catch it

options.name: Soft-deprecation status field
options.summary: Add a status field ('active'|'deprecated') to Service and rework seedServices() to upsert matched entries and mark missing ones deprecated instead of deleting.

files_to_modify.changes: Refresh catalog data; rework seedServices() to update existing docs and mark removed ones deprecated

pros: Satisfies AC's 'removed or clearly deprecated' without breaking Scenario references
Reusable pattern for future catalog refreshes
cons: Touches model + routes + a UI surface, more review surface than option 1
options.risk_details: Multi-file change but no destructive operation; no automated tests to verify

options.name: Full re-seed with idempotent 3-way diff
options.summary: Rewrite seedServices() to diff every run against the source (update changed fields, deprecate missing, create new), restructuring the source-of-truth data file.

files_to_modify.changes: Restructure into diff-friendly source arrays + new diffing seed function
Add any new categories required by refreshed services
Extend mapping for any new categories

pros: Most maintainable long-term for future catalog refreshes
cons: More verification effort with zero test coverage
options.risk_details: Broad refactor of seeding logic with no test safety net
